# Ahmeds Textiles

> > Ahmeds Textiles is a South African supplier of textiles, sewing machines, event furniture, tableware, cookware, and home décor products.

Based in South Africa, Ahmeds Textiles offers a comprehensive range of products including Singer and Brother sewing machines, Bon Voyage cookware, wedding and event furniture, glassware and tableware for catering, window treatments, and fabric materials. The company serves both retail customers and event professionals with quality homeware and textile solutions.

## Key Topics

- Singer sewing machines
- Brother sewing machines
- Bon Voyage cookware
- Wedding and event furniture
- Glassware and drinkware
- Tableware and charger plates
- Non-stick cookware
- Domestic and electronic sewing
- Mini Matt fabric
- Chenille upholstery
- Ready-made lace sheers
- Kingstar industrial machines
- Event seating and couches
- Curtain rods and blinds
- Khanga fabric
